format: assembly (ARM64/Zephyr vector table and exception handling)
description: This file contains the ARM64 vector table and exception handling routines for Zephyr RTOS, including macros for saving/restoring registers during exceptions, and handling different exception levels and types.

methods.name: z_arm64_enter_exc
methods.description: Macro to save registers and prepare for exception handling based on exception level and type.

methods.name: z_arm64_serror
methods.description: Handles fatal system errors during exceptions.

methods.name: z_arm64_quick_stack_check
methods.description: Checks and switches to a safe exception stack if needed.

methods.name: z_arm64_exit_exc
methods.description: Restores registers and returns from exception.
